rules.statement: An order for an interim injunction made by a District Court may be set aside by that Court on application made thereto, by any party dissatisfied with such order.
rules.supporting_quote: Section 666 of the Civil Procedure Code states that an order for an injunction or enjoining order made may be discharged, or varied or set aside by the Court, on application made there to, by any party dissatisfied with such order.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 666 of the Civil Procedure Code

meta.parties: Gunasekera v. Archbishop Of Colombo And Others
